title: Administrator - K. Configure Inspection Templates (Settings > Service)
steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Go to Settings > Service.
  3. Open Inspection Templates.
  4. Create/edit a template.
expected:
Step 2: Settings > Service is accessible.
Step 3: The Inspection Templates section is available.
Step 4: Templates can be created/edited/published/archived/restored/deleted/duplicated with fields: Checklist, Short Text, Long Text, Measurements, Photo, Instructions. (Gated by Settings > Service - SV-8095 AC6.)
